title: Quantum Well Energy Level Explorer
description: Bound states of a finite square quantum well with different effective masses in the well and the barriers. The left plot shows the conduction band edge, the energy levels, and their wavefunctions or probability densities, with the infinite-well levels for comparison. The right plot shows the staircase density of states of the well and the square-root density of states of the bulk material on the same energy axis. A table lists each level, the infinite-well value, and the probability in the barriers. Sliders set the well width and the conduction band offset; a menu selects GaAs/AlGaAs, InGaAs/InP, or GaN/AlGaN.

learningObjectives: Explain why confinement raises the lowest allowed energy above the bulk band edge
Calculate the ground-state energy of a quantum well of given width and material
Compare the density of states of a quantum well with that of the bulk material and relate the difference to the threshold of a quantum well laser
prerequisites: Effective mass and the density of states

pedagogical.interactionPattern: Parameter sliders with two linked real-time plots on a shared energy axis and a table of levels
pedagogical.instructionalStrategy: Hand calculation with the infinite-well formula, followed by comparison with the numerical finite-well result
assessmentOpportunities: Compute the infinite-well ground-state energy and compare with the finite-well value
Explain why the finite-well levels lie below the infinite-well levels
Relate the effective mass to the confinement energy across material systems
Explain the laser threshold advantage from the step in the density of states

equations: even states: (k/m_w) tan(k L_z/2) = kappa/m_b; odd states: -(k/m_w) cot(k L_z/2) = kappa/m_b
k = sqrt(2 m_w E)/hbar; kappa = sqrt(2 m_b (dE_C - E))/hbar
infinite well: E_n = n^2 pi^2 hbar^2 / (2 m_w L_z^2)
g_QW = m_w/(pi hbar^2 L_z) per subband; g_bulk = (1/2 pi^2)(2 m_w/hbar^2)^(3/2) sqrt(E)
assumptions: Electron effective masses (well, barrier) in units of m_0: GaAs 0.067, Al0.3Ga0.7As 0.092; In0.53Ga0.47As 0.041, InP 0.080; GaN 0.20, Al0.25Ga0.75N 0.23
Square well with flat bands; energies measured from the conduction band edge of the well
limitations: No polarization field: the GaN/AlGaN option shows the effect of the effective mass only
Parabolic bands; the barrier mass does not follow the band offset slider
Conduction band only; hole levels are not shown
